cases.name: Tahnesia Watts
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She had a passion for taking care of those in need and she was great at her job. She was currently working as a CNA healthcare provider in Waterbury. She had a huge, loving heart and was always known for bringing people together, especially family. She was a loving and caring mother. Tahnesia had an infectious smile and a distinctive laugh that would light up any room. She enjoyed music, cooking and entertaining, and most of all having a good time laughing and dancing with friends. She loved life and wanted everyone around her to be happy and enjoy their lives as well. Tahnesia will be missed by all that knew her."

cases.name: Catherine Nicole Curry Roberts
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Catherine was a graduate of Bay State College and the University of Connecticut. Catherine worked for Abbott Terrence Daycare Center for approximately twenty years as an early childhood development instructor. Determined to continue her education, Catherine enrolled in the University of Connecticut, and for the last three years has been employed by Aspire Living & Learning as a Behavior Therapist. Catherine’s smile lite up a room. To know her was to love her. Catherine loved to dance and was a big sports fan. Her favorite past time was to bake her sweet potato pies Catherine was a devoted mother, daughter, sister and friend. She will be missed."
